title: Replace SessionStateMachine's nested sign-pure InputBridge with the shared V2 InputBridge
description: Follow-up filed from rev-t046 MEDIUM-1 on TASK-046. A third nested InputBridge copy survives at Barcade/Assets/Barcade/Core/Runtime/Loop/SessionStateMachine.cs:713-742 (line numbers will shift with the TASK-051 fix round) using the SIGN-PURE stick convention (ToStickXY, diagonals ±1/±1), contradicting the NORMALIZED convention documented as canonical on the shared Barcade.Core.Microgames.V2.InputBridge (TASK-046, GDD §1.3 digital-stick rationale). Behaviorally identical today — InputInterpreter.ToDirection8 is sign-only and no magnitude consumer exists — but it is the same latent drift hazard TASK-046 killed for the per-mechanic copies, and its doc comment (~705-711) cites a duplication rationale TASK-046 removed. Work: replace the nested class with the shared V2 InputBridge (SessionStateMachine already consumes V2.PlayerInput[], so likely drop-in), delete ToStickXY, remove the stale doc comment. Preserve the FSM input-boundary and zero-alloc pins (all byte-unmodified). CARRY-IN RIDER (rev-t046 LOW-1, doc-only): add a one-line doc comment on ApuntaMicrogame.DirectionToUnit (V2/ApuntaMicrogame.cs:418) — mirrors InputBridge.ToUnitVector's values but is aim geometry, not the input convention; do not fold (folding would couple ballistics to the input convention).
acceptance_criteria: SessionStateMachine's nested private InputBridge class and ToStickXY are deleted; the FSM consumes the shared Barcade.Core.Microgames.V2.InputBridge instead.
Full suite stays green; the FSM input-boundary pins (gameplay-input-forwarding, join-button, final-wager gesture tests) and zero-alloc sensors pass unmodified.
The stale duplication-rationale doc comment is removed; any convention note on the FSM side defers to the shared type's canonical NORMALIZED documentation.
Rider: DirectionToUnit carries the do-not-fold cross-reference doc comment per rev-t046 LOW-1.

comments.author: dev-t101
comments.body:
Hand-off. Two commits on master: 6852bc8 refactor(core) = nested InputBridge + ToStickXY deleted, field now typed V2.InputBridge directly (V2 alias pre-existing); includes the one-line DirectionToUnit do-not-fold doc rider (ApuntaMicrogame.cs:417, cites rev-t046 LOW-1) — folded in as a directly-related one-line doc touch, flagged per briefing. 5bd1962 test(core) = TASK-052 rider landed: DifferentSessionSeeds_ProduceDifferentBonusStarDraws, RunWith(rngSeed:1, sessionSeed:777) vs (rngSeed:1, sessionSeed:778) through the explicit-seed overload, asserts (First,Second) star tuple differs; run in isolation first to confirm genuinely green (not a hand-picked collision), passed first try. Suite 554/554 (553+1).

Stop-condition check per briefing: _inputBridge has exactly ONE consumer in the whole file — _interpreter.Tick(_inputBridge) (~line 349); nothing else reads fed StickX/StickY. Clean drop-in confirmed: both types implement IReadOnlyPlayerInputs with identical SetSource(PlayerInput[])/For(PlayerSlot) signatures; InputInterpreter.Tick takes IReadOnlyPlayerInputs.

AC2: existing FSM pins (input-boundary, join-button, wager-gesture, zero-alloc) byte-unmodified — git diff on SessionStateMachineTests.cs shows only the one new test method appended. AC3: stale duplication-rationale doc comment gone with the deleted class; field declaration now points to V2.InputBridge's own class doc rather than re-describing the convention. No Unity-gate step needed — pure engine-free Core change. Surface discipline: Loop/SessionStateMachine.cs + its tests + the one ApuntaMicrogame doc line; Scoring/ and Editor tooling untouched.
